prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean woman, a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 40s silver fox goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, silver-white low chignon knot at the nape — full body iris field irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET iris blossoms cascading the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID EMERALD leaf blade detail filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A light dusting of soot sits on her cheek and chin, with a little dirt on her hands and bare feet. Her expression is a still, steady expression. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a long thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that runs back along her sides to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, the chains pulled taut by its weight so her arms are drawn back. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links. Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, leaning forward against the pull with her arms drawn back along her sides to the chains, the iron ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin glossy nails violet emerald tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
